<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the dominant ion at m/z 127.0997 likely corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈126.092 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈8 % M+1 intensity) indicates about 8 carbon atoms. The formula C₈H₁₄O matches this mass (calculated monoisotopic mass 126.104 Da) and is the closest reasonable candidate, consistent with the observed carbon count.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
